summary: Preserve lifecycle fences in batched identity-aware reads

replay.detail: No persisted fact or hash contract changes. The canonical rename-request hash tag is new to this branch and is not present on origin/main.

rules.detail: Desired reads check pending and invalid lifecycle records even for agents without naming heads. Mission specification, definition and run-header batches preserve naming-head and pending-record refusals for original names and aliases, including missions without runs. These checks remain inside the existing batched SQL statements.

recovery.detail: Incomplete or conflicting lifecycle evidence returns lifecycle-unavailable instead of exposing a declaration through an unfenced read.
